title: 절제 확대
prompt:
Create a NEW super-deformed big-headed PIXEL ART version of the attached blond young adult male dual-sword warrior, one front-view full-body sprite, transparent background. The image is IDENTITY/OUTFIT/PIXEL MATERIAL reference only; deliberately REPLACE its current long body/small actual face proportions.
Option1 restrained enlargement, softly tapered young male jaw, calm almond brown eyes, tiny neutral closed smile. The actual FACE width and brow-to-chin height relative to whole-character height should each be about40% larger than original. Head with hair occupies about40% of character height.
The skull INSIDE the existing blond hair and the visible cheek/jaw/forehead facial plane must be much larger; NOT just enlarged eyes or inflated hair. Preserve the spiky layered blond hairstyle, swept fringe and golden color naturally wrapped around the expanded skull, no bald character. Keep face youthful MALE, brown moderate almond eyes, clear nose/mouth, no infant cheeks or baby anatomy. Naturally redraw short neck, shoulders, compact chest, arms, pelvis and shorter legs to support the big skull; no pasted/stretched head.

Give a strongly readable enlarged face from brows to chin. These are design aims, not printed guides. Complete hair, feet and weapon tips must fit with generous margins.
Preserve silver armor, blue scarf and short lowered hood, blue waist cloth, brown double belts/pouch/trousers, no long cape. Anatomical RIGHT/viewerLEFT crescent pauldron and silver plated shin/boot; LEFT/viewerRIGHT blue cloth boot with metal protectors. Exactly two swords: anatomical RIGHT hand/viewerLEFT LONGSWORD with blue diagonal blade accents, wing-shaped silver guard and ring knuckle guard; LEFT hand/viewerRIGHT SHORT ANGULAR DAGGER. Hands truly wrap handles, continuous wrist/palm and opposing thumb, coherent sword axis. Longsword down-right across front toward opposite foot; dagger down at side. Both feet planted, front0-degree idle, same camera and quiet neutral expression.
Crisp deliberate PIXEL clusters and dark colored outline, silver cel facets, cobalt cloth and warm leather exactly as established reference. No3D or smooth painted render. No background, floor shadow, text, grid, extra weapons, extra arms, watermark. The result must look unmistakably more true-head-and-face dominant than the reference at equal displayed body height.
